sourceCode: _pretenured_cull: anArg   "Execute the receiver with one or zero arguments depending on the receiver"   "([ 12 ] cull: 13)>>> 12 "   "([:x | x + 12] cull: 3)>>> 15"   <reflection:   'Message sending and code execution - Runtime and Evaluation'>   ^ numArgs = 0        ifTrue: [ self value ]        ifFalse: [ self value: anArg ]

_pretenured_open: aResolvable writable: aBoolean   "Resolve aResolvable into an absolute path, then ask the store to open the file at	that path using the specified access mode."   | path |   path := self resolve: aResolvable.   ^ store handleClass        _pretenured_open: (FileReference fileSystem: self path: path)        writable: aBoolean

_pretenured_at: key put: anObject   "Set the value at key to be anObject.  If key is not found, create a	new entry for key and set is value to anObject. Answer anObject."   "(Dictionary new at: #color put: #blue; yourself) >>> (Dictionary new add: #color->#blue; yourself)"   "(Dictionary new at: #color put: #blue; at: #color put: #red; yourself) >>> (Dictionary new add: #color->#red; yourself)"   | index assoc |   index := self findElementOrNil: key.   assoc := array at: index.   assoc      ifNil: [            self               atNewIndex: index               put: (Association _pretenured_key: key value: anObject) ]      ifNotNil: [ assoc value: anObject ].   ^ anObject

_pretenured_collect: aBlock   | nextValue result |   result := self species new: self size.   nextValue := start.   1 to: result size do: [ :i |         result at: i put: (aBlock value: nextValue).         nextValue := nextValue + step ].   ^ result

_pretenured_newForEncoding: string   "Return a new character encoder object for an encoding described by string.	Search for a subclass that handles it and delegate (subclassResponsibility)."   | concreteSubclass |   concreteSubclass := self _pretenured_allSubclasses                          _pretenured_detect: [ :each |                          each _pretenured_handlesEncoding: string ]                          ifNone: [ ^ self default ].   ^ concreteSubclass newForEncoding: string

_pretenured_binaryReadStreamOn: aResolvable   "Resolve the argument into an absolute path and open a file handle on the file	at that path. Ask the handle to give us a read stream for reading the file."   ^ (self _pretenured_open: aResolvable writable: false)        binaryReadStream

_pretenured_readFromInternal: aFileReference   "Read data frame from a CSV file"   | stream reader df |   stream := aFileReference _pretenured_readStream.   reader := NeoCSVReader on: stream.   reader separator: self separator.   self readColumnNamesWith: reader.   self readRowsWith: reader.   reader close.   df := self _pretenured_createDataFrame.   ^ df
_pretenured_readStreamEncoded: anEncoding   ^ ZnCharacterReadStream        _pretenured_on: self _pretenured_binaryReadStream        encoding: anEncoding
initialize   super initialize.   contents := Array2D newTenured
_pretenured_on: aCollection   "Answer an instance of me, streaming over the elements of aCollection."   ^ self basicNewTenured on: aCollection
_pretenured_binaryReadStream   "Answer a buffered binary read stream on the receiver"   ^ ZnBufferedReadStream on:        (filesystem _pretenured_binaryReadStreamOn: self path)
_pretenured_writeStream   ^ WriteStream _pretenured_on: self

_pretenured_handlesEncoding: string   "Return true when my instances handle the encoding described by string"   ^ self byteTextConverters includesKey:        (self _pretenured_canonicalEncodingIdentifier: string)

_pretenured_columnNames: aCollection   "Sets the column names of a DataFrame with contents of the collection aCollection"   | type |   aCollection size = self numberOfColumns ifFalse: [      SizeMismatch signal: 'Wrong number of column names' ].   aCollection asSet size = aCollection size ifFalse: [      Error signal: 'All column names must be distinct' ].   self columnNames ifNotNil: [         self columnNames _pretenured_withIndexDo: [               :currentColumnName               :i |               type := dataTypes at: currentColumnName.               dataTypes removeKey: currentColumnName.               dataTypes _pretenured_at: (aCollection at: i) put: type ] ].   columnNames := aCollection asOrderedCollection

_pretenured_detect: aBlock ifNone: exceptionBlock   "Evaluate aBlock with each of the receiver's elements as the argument.	Answer the first element for which aBlock evaluates to true. If none	evaluate to true, then evaluate the argument, exceptionBlock."   "(#(1 2) detect: #even ifNone: [0]) >>> 2"   "(#(1 3) detect: #even ifNone: [0]) >>> 0"   "('Hello' detect: #isLowercase ifNone: [$X]) >>> $e"   "('LOL' detect: #isLowercase ifNone: [$X]) >>> $X"   ^ self        _pretenured_detect: aBlock        ifFound: [ :element | element ]        ifNone: exceptionBlock
_pretenured_on: aReference writable: aBoolean   ^ self newTenured setReference: aReference writable: aBoolean
_pretenured_encoding: encoding   encoder := encoding _pretenured_asZnCharacterEncoder
_pretenured_canonicalEncodingIdentifier: string   ^ (string _pretenured_select: [ :each | each isAlphaNumeric ])        asLowercase
_pretenured_createDataFrame   | df |   df := DataFrame _pretenured_withRows: rows columnNames: columnNames.   self includeRowNames ifTrue: [ df privateRowNames: rowNames ].   ^ df
initialize   super initialize.   dataTypes := Dictionary new.   contents := DataFrameInternal newTenured.   self setDefaultRowColumnNames.   self calculateDataTypes
_pretenured_open: aReference writable: aBoolean   ^ (self _pretenured_on: aReference writable: aBoolean) open
_pretenured_to: stop   "Answer an Interval from the receiver up to the argument, stop,	incrementing by 1."   ^ Interval _pretenured_from: self to: stop by: 1
_pretenured_key: newKey value: newValue   "Answer an instance of me with the arguments as the key and value of	the association."   ^ self basicNewTenured key: newKey value: newValue

_pretenured_withIndexDo: elementAndIndexBlock   "Just like do: except that the iteration index supplies the second argument to the block"   "(Array streamContents: [:stream| #(11 22 13) withIndexDo: [ :each :i | stream nextPut: (each * each + i)]]) >>> #(122 486 172)"   1 to: self size do: [ :index |   elementAndIndexBlock value: (self at: index) value: index ]

_pretenured_subclasses   "Answer a Set containing the receiver's subclasses."   <reflection:   'Class structural inspection - Iterating and querying hierarchy'>   ^ subclasses        ifNil: [ #(  ) ]        ifNotNil: [ subclasses _pretenured_copy ]
_pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays   ^ self newTenured _pretenured_initializeRows: anArrayOfArrays

_pretenured_ifNotEmpty: notEmptyBlock ifEmpty: emptyBlock   "Evaluate emptyBlock if I'm empty, notEmptyBlock otherwise	 If the notEmptyBlock has an argument, eval with the receiver as its argument"   ^ self isEmpty        ifTrue: [ emptyBlock value ]        ifFalse: [ notEmptyBlock _pretenured_cull: self ]

_pretenured_copy   "Answer another instance just like the receiver. Subclasses typically override postCopy; they typically do not override shallowCopy. Copy is a template method in the sense of Design Patterns. So do not override it. Override postCopy instead. Pay attention that normally you should call postCopy of your superclass too."   ^ self shallowCopy postCopy

_pretenured_asArrayOfColumns   "Converts DataFrame to the array of columns"   "(#(#(1 2) #(3 4)) asDataFrame asArrayOfColumns) >>> (#(#(1 3) #(2 4)))"   "(#(#(r1c1 r1c2) #(r2c1 r2c2)) asDataFrame asArrayOfColumns) >>> (#(#(r1c1 r2c1) #(r1c2 r2c2)))"   ^ contents _pretenured_asArrayOfColumns

_pretenured_from: startInteger to: stopInteger by: stepInteger   "Answer an instance of me, starting at startNumber, ending at	stopNumber, and with an interval increment of stepNumber."   ^ self newTenured        setFrom: startInteger        to: stopInteger        by: stepInteger

_pretenured_calculateDataTypes   self _pretenured_asArrayOfColumns _pretenured_doWithIndex: [         :column         :i |         self dataTypes            _pretenured_at: (self columnNames at: i)            put: column calculateDataType ]
_pretenured_doWithIndex: elementAndIndexBlock   "Use the new version with consistent naming"   ^ self _pretenured_withIndexDo: elementAndIndexBlock

_pretenured_detect: aBlock ifFound: foundBlock ifNone: exceptionBlock   "Evaluate aBlock with each of the receiver's elements as the argument.	If some element evaluates aBlock to true, then cull this element into	foundBlock and answer the result of this evaluation.	If none evaluate to true, then evaluate exceptionBlock."   "(#(1 2) detect: #even ifFound: #negated ifNone: [0]) >>> -2"   "(#(1 3) detect: #even ifFound: #negated ifNone: [0]) >>> 0"   "('Hello' detect: #isLowercase ifFound: #uppercase ifNone: [$X]) >>> $E"   "('LOL' detect: #isLowercase ifFound: #uppercase ifNone: [$X]) >>> $X"   self _pretenured_do: [ :each |      (aBlock value: each) ifTrue: [ ^ foundBlock cull: each ] ].   ^ exceptionBlock value

_pretenured_asArrayOfColumns   "Converts DataFrameInternal to the array of columns"   ^ (1 to: self numberOfColumns) _pretenured_collect: [ :j |           (1 _pretenured_to: self numberOfRows) collect: [ :i |              self at: i at: j ] ]

_pretenured_stringStreamContents: block   "Like String streamContents: block	but reusing the underlying buffer for improved efficiency"   stringStream ifNil: [      stringStream := (String new: 32) _pretenured_writeStream ].   stringStream reset.   block value: stringStream.   ^ stringStream contents
_pretenured_on: wrappedStream encoding: encoding   ^ self new        on: wrappedStream;        _pretenured_encoding: encoding;        yourself
_pretenured_do: aBlock   "Override the superclass for performance reasons."   firstIndex to: lastIndex do: [ :index |   aBlock value: (array at: index) ]

_pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays columnNames: anArrayOfColumnNames   ^ anArrayOfArrays        _pretenured_ifNotEmpty: [              (self _pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays)                 _pretenured_columnNames: anArrayOfColumnNames;                 yourself ]        ifEmpty: [ self withColumnNames: anArrayOfColumnNames ]
_pretenured_initializeRows: anArrayOfArrays   contents := DataFrameInternal withRows: anArrayOfArrays.   self _pretenured_setDefaultRowColumnNames.   self _pretenured_calculateDataTypes
_pretenured_setDefaultRowColumnNames   self privateRowNames: (1 _pretenured_to: self numberOfRows).   self columnNames: (1 to: self numberOfColumns)

_pretenured_allSubclasses   "Answer an orderedCollection of the receiver's and the receiver's descendent's subclasses. "   <reflection:   'Class structural inspection - Iterating and querying hierarchy'>   | scan scanTop |   scan := OrderedCollection withAll: self subclasses.   scanTop := 1.   [ scanTop > scan size ] whileFalse: [         scan addAll: (scan at: scanTop) _pretenured_subclasses.         scanTop := scanTop + 1 ].   ^ scan

_pretenured_new: newSize streamContents: blockWithArg   "A variant of #streamContents: where the initial or even final size is given to optimize memory consumption"   "(Array new: 3 streamContents: [ :out | 3 timesRepeat: [ out nextPut: 42 ] ]) >>> #(42 42 42)"   | stream |   stream := WriteStream _pretenured_on:                (self streamSpecies new: newSize).   blockWithArg value: stream.   "If the write position of stream is at the end of the internal buffer of stream (originalContents),	we can return it directly instead of making a copy as contents would do"   ^ stream position = stream originalContents size        ifTrue: [ stream originalContents ]        ifFalse: [ stream contents ]

_pretenured_select: aBlock   "Optimized version of Collection>>#select:"   "(#(1 2 3 4) select: [:each | each > 2 ]) >>> #(3 4)"   | each |   ^ self species        _pretenured_new: self size        streamContents: [ :stream |              1 to: self size do: [ :index |                    (aBlock value: (each := self at: index)) ifTrue: [                       stream nextPut: each ] ] ]

_pretenured_asZnCharacterEncoder   "Return a ZnCharacterEncoder instance using the receiver as identifier"   " 'UTF-8' asZnCharacterEncoder "   ^ ZnCharacterEncoder _pretenured_newForEncoding: self
_pretenured_readStream   ^ self _pretenured_readStreamEncoded: 'utf8'

readFrom: aFileReference   "Read data frame from a CSV file"   | df |   df := self _pretenured_readFromInternal: aFileReference.   shouldInferTypes ifTrue: [         DataFrameTypeDetector new            columnTypes: columnTypes;            detectTypesAndConvert: df ].   ^ df

readUnquotedField   (self atEnd or: [ self peekSeparator or: [ self peekEndOfLine ] ])      ifTrue: [ ^ emptyFieldValue ].   ^ self _pretenured_stringStreamContents: [ :stream |           [           self atEnd or: [              self peekSeparator or: [ self peekEndOfLine ] ] ]              whileFalse: [ stream nextPut: self nextChar ] ]
